1230:     "statement": "private function getAllowShowResults(): bool {\n\t\t// edit rights include access to results\n\t\tif ($this->getAllowEditPoll()) {\n\t\t\treturn true;\n\t\t}\n\n\t\t// no access to poll, deny\n\t\tif (!$this->getAllowAccessPoll()) {\n\t\t\treturn false;\n\t\t}\n\n\t\t// show results, when poll is closed\n\t\tif ($this->getShowResults() === Poll::SHOW_RESULTS_CLOSED && $this->getIsExpired()) {\n\t\t\treturn true;\n\t\t}\n\t\t// return poll settings\n\t\treturn $this->getShowResults() === Poll::SHOW_RESULTS_ALWAYS;\n\t}",

1240:     "statement": "private function getAllowAddOptions(): bool {\n\t\t// Edit right includes adding new options\n\t\tif ($this->getAllowEditPoll()) {\n\t\t\treturn true;\n\t\t}\n\n\t\t// deny, if user has no access right to this poll\n\t\tif (!$this->getAllowAccessPoll()) {\n\t\t\treturn false;\n\t\t}\n\n\t\t// deny, if user is not allowed to vote\n\t\tif (!$this->getAllowVote()) {\n\t\t\treturn false;\n\t\t}\n\n\t\t// public shares are not allowed to add options\n\t\tif ($this->userSession->getShare()->getType() === Share::TYPE_PUBLIC) {\n\t\t\treturn false;\n\t\t}\n\n\t\t// Request for option proposals is expired, deny\n\t\tif ($this->getProposalPeriodIsExpired()) {\n\t\t\treturn false;\n\t\t}\n\n\t\t// Locked Users are not allowed to add options\n\t\tif (boolval($this->getIsCurrentUserLocked())) {\n\t\t\treturn false;\n\t\t}\n\n\t\t// Allow, if poll requests proposals\n\t\treturn $this->getAllowProposals() === Poll::PROPOSAL_ALLOW;\n\t}",

1: # Polling Application
2: 
3: ## Overview
4: 
5: A **Polling Application** is an application for creating polls — small question instruments with predefined answer options — distributing them to a group through a low-friction participation path, and computing an aggregate result of the votes. The aggregate, not the individual responses, is the poll's deliverable: the poll exists to produce a shared answer to a question ("which option does the group prefer?"), not records to be processed afterwards.
6: 
7: The defining structure is small:
8: 
9: ```text
10: Poll (question + predefined answer options)
11: └── Lightweight distributed voting (a single act per participant)
12:     └── Computed vote aggregate (counts/percentages per option)
13: ```
14:

161:

191: | Group Availability Scheduling Application | a time-finding poll for one occasion: options are candidate times, answers are availability declarations, and the endpoint is one chosen time; a generic poll tool can host a date poll, but the scheduling loop defines that Type |
192: | Questionnaire Application | sibling in the same directory family; the instrument/collection seam with forms and surveys is decided at that Type's own pass |
193: | Meeting / Webinar Platforms, Social Networks, Forum Software | their native poll features are embedded capabilities of those container products, not instances of this Type; the primary-surface test decides |

200: 
201: - StrawPoll — standalone web poll maker, anonymous-first, free with ad-funding
202: - PollUnit — standalone freemium decision tool with votings as one mode beside tables, surveys and contests
203: - Polly — collaboration-platform-native polls for Slack, Teams and meeting tools (business tier)

202: - PollUnit — standalone freemium decision tool with votings as one mode beside tables, surveys and contests
203: - Polly — collaboration-platform-native polls for Slack, Teams and meeting tools (business tier)
204:

One standalone free-poll product (Xoyondo) was unreachable (access denied) and is recorded as market context only. Precise operational details — participant limits, vote-token lifetimes, exact duplicate-check parameters, retention defaults — are intentionally not asserted anywhere in this document.

20: # Free meeting schedule tool
21: - :next_track_button: Easy poll creation
22: - :hammer_and_wrench: Highly customizable
23:     - :envelope: Make your poll confidential by hiding the results until you want them to be discovered
24:     - :dark_sunglasses: Obfuscate participants' names from other participants or set strong anonymous mode
25:     - :timer_clock: Set an automatic expiry date
26:     - :heavy_plus_sign: Allow participants to add more options
27:     - :white_check_mark: Limit votes per option or user
28:     - ... :currency_exchange: and a lot more
29: - :mailbox_with_mail: Invite everyone you want
30: - :rocket: Export your poll to different spreadsheet formats or HTML
31: - :red_envelope: Let Polls automatically remind your invited users
32: - :speech_balloon: Comments
33: - :ballot_box_with_check: Confirm options after poll closing
34: - :loudspeaker: Subscribe to notifications per poll
35: - :date: Get hints about possible conflicting entries in your calendar around the date option
36: - :toolbox: Usable via REST-API

38:     - Circles
39:     - Contacts
40:     - Activity

This app can only be maintained with your help and with your proven patience. This is the biggest value the app could get over the last years since I took over the maintenance of Polls.
